# Security

This game is an entirely client-side browser app. There is no game server, account system, or network protocol to attack.

## Supported builds

| Build | Supported |
|---|---|
| Latest `main` / `master` | Yes |
| Older tags and local forks | No |

## Report a vulnerability

Use **Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository (GitHub private advisory). Do not open a public issue for security reports.
